          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Mark current room read</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>?</kbd></dt><dd>This help</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-sidebar-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-sidebar-title">Sidebar rooms</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt>Right-click</dt><dd>Room menu (favourites, mute, categories)</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Room menu from the keyboard</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-messages-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-messages-title">Messages</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd></dt><dd>Move between messages</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd></dt><dd>First / last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>☰</kbd></dt><dd>Message menu</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Move between menu items</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd> in a menu</dt><dd>Close the menu</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-composer-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-composer-title">Composer</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Shift</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>New line</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> in an empty composer</dt><dd>Edit your last message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>⌘</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd></dt><dd>Send message</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Ctrl</kbd> <kbd>B</kbd> / <kbd>I</kbd></dt><dd>Bold / italic</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="shortcuts-pickers-title">
        <h3 id="shortcuts-pickers-title">Pickers and panels</h3>
        <dl>
          <div><dt><kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> in the emoji picker</dt><dd>Switch emoji tabs</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> <kbd>Enter</kbd> in the Drive picker</dt><dd>Choose and insert a file</dd></div>
          <div><dt><kbd>Esc</kbd></dt><dd>Close members, threads and menus</dd></div>
        </dl>
      </section>
    </div>

    <p class="shortcuts-sheet__note">Shortcuts never fire while typing, unless chorded with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <kbd>⌘</kbd> or <kbd>Alt</kbd>. <kbd>Esc</kbd> closes open dialogs, menus and panels first, and marks the current room read when nothing is open.</p>
  </div>
</dialog>
